title: 2027 Work Plan
rule: All Tier 3 trees, half of Tier 2 and 68 Tier 1 trees, 1,200 in all, on 89 field days. Pruning, watering 150 and bulbs in 200 beds are done on trees in the 1,200. Pruning covers the 114 CB3 zelkovas planted 2 to 10 years before their pruning date, by the NYC Parks planted date; zelkovas with no planted date are left out. 41 are pruned on Jun to Aug field days, marked in the stop labels; the other 73 are pruned on six Saturday Citizen Pruner days, listed here as days of their own. Each field day is made of whole block segments; three oversized segments are split into parts.
